title: Channel B — push gateway (persistent TCP, framed JSON)
description: Realtime control/telemetry over a raw TCP socket to the getSockAddr ip:port. WIRE FRAMING (not expressible in JSON Schema): each frame is UTF-8 JSON text followed by the 3-byte delimiter 0x23 0x09 0x23 ('#\t#') IN BOTH DIRECTIONS — the server MUST also terminate its frames with '#\t#' (no length prefix). DIRECTION ASYMMETRY (corrected 2026-10-07, see ../CHANNEL_B_INBOUND.md): DEVICE->CLOUD frames are the plaintext message object itself (top-level 'infoType'+'data'; the device never encrypts). CLOUD->DEVICE frames are DOUBLE-NESTED: {"encrypt":0|1,"data":<MESSAGE>} where MESSAGE = {"infoType":N,"data":{...},"dInfo":{"ts":"...","userId":"..."}} — the robot dispatches the CONTENTS of the outer 'data'. 'encrypt' must be an integer (0 = outer data is the plaintext MESSAGE; 1 = outer data is base64(AES-128-ECB(jsoncpp(MESSAGE), session[:16]))); a frame without 'encrypt' is silently dropped, and a MESSAGE without an integer 'infoType' is dropped one step later (log-only 'WTF!!! Recv Json'). 'dInfo.ts'/'dInfo.userId' must be STRINGS for any command whose handler replies (FUN_00459100 refuses otherwise). AES key = first 16 bytes of data.session from cleanPack/register. KEEPALIVE: device sends 21006 Ping; the server MUST pong with the enveloped form (see pong_21006_cloudToDevice).
$comment: Per-infoType MESSAGE shapes below (as $defs). For device->cloud frames, match on the frame's infoType directly. For cloud->device frames, unwrap the outer 'data' (the MESSAGE) and match on ITS infoType.

infoType.description: message type code (distinct from EID_* bus ids)

connectionType.description: only value emitted by firmware is 1 (primary control connection)

reason.description: present on failures, e.g. 'invalid json format !!'

encrypt.description: MANDATORY integer. 0 = outer data is the plaintext MESSAGE object; any other value (use 1) = outer data is base64(AES-128-ECB(jsoncpp(MESSAGE), session[:16])). Missing => frame silently dropped (msg['encrypt'].isInt() gate in FUN_00457f08).

data.description: the MESSAGE object when encrypt:0; the base64-AES string when encrypt:1. The robot dispatches the CONTENTS of this member — it must contain an integer infoType (see cloudMessage).

cloudMessage.description: The nested MESSAGE the robot dispatches (contents of the cloud frame's outer 'data'). Same shape the device itself emits, plus 'dInfo'.

infoType.description: MESSAGE-level type — this is what FUN_00470b28 matches (must be an integer)

dInfo.description: reply correlation echoed in the HTTP reply (sn&infoType&ts&userId&data); ts/userId must be STRINGS whenever the handler replies, else the reply is never POSTed

cloudCommand.description: Alias of cloudFrame (an enveloped cloud->device command).

ping_21006_deviceToCloud.description: KEEPALIVE Ping from the device: {"infoType":21006,"data":{}}. The server MUST pong (enveloped — see pong_21006_cloudToDevice) or the device reconnects (heart_online_ld.cpp; watchdog = last activity + 15 s, checked 1/s).

pong_21006_cloudToDevice.description: Server's pong — enveloped: {"encrypt":0,"data":{"infoType":21006,"data":{}}}. Receipt marks the device online (RecvPong, via the 21006 handler FUN_00457b30); a boolean 'isExistConnect' inside the INNER data also sets the app-online flag (what enables status pushes and map uploads). A flat/unenveloped pong only refreshes the link timer and never reaches the handler.

data.description: inner payload; put {"isExistConnect":true} here for app-online

lz4_len.description: length of the LZ4 stream inside 'map'

map.description: base64( LZ4_compress( width*height occupancy cells, row-major ) )

chargeHandlePhi.description: dock orientation as (int)((phi+pi)*1000) thousandths of a radian (0..6283), NOT degrees

region.description: a room or forbidden zone; appears in map 'area[]' and in SetAreaTactics(21003). name/tag/mode are copied into fixed 32-byte buffers without a length check — keep name/tag <=31 and mode <=30 UTF-8 bytes (FUNC_MAP.md §4).

active.description: region state; a no-go/virtual-wall zone is active:"forbid"

forbidType.description: used only when active == "forbid" (it is always present in the robot's output)

setAreaTactics_21003.description: MESSAGE object (wrap it in the cloud envelope to send). Replaces the whole region list; a read-modify-write must start from the 21004 reply, not from the 20002 area[] (FUNC_MAP.md §4/§5.1).

cleanPath_21011.description: The robot's 21011 reply object, POSTed as the data= value of the HTTP cleanPack/response body (sn=%s&infoType=21011&ts=%s&userId=%s&data=...) — NOT a Channel-B TCP frame.

startPos.description: index of first point in this chunk

rc_21020_cloudToDevice.description: REMOTE CONTROL, as the MESSAGE object (wrap in the cloud envelope): {"encrypt":0,"data":{"infoType":21020,"data":{"ctrlCode":...}}}. data.ctrlCode selects the action (3001..3013; FUNC_COMMANDS.md §3); optional data.params (e.g. {speed_v,speed_w} for 3013). The robot sends NO reply on Channel B — confirm via the status 'mode' echo. The packId/'rfctrl' ack belongs to the separate LAN UDP remote-control handler (FUN_00414140), not this channel.
